Question: Some people in my college say rhat qayamat is very near and that imam mehdi is born and that dajjal has also come and they relate it to the gulf war of 1992 and they say they have met imam mehdi or isaa aelehisalaam i dont know it but they say such things is it true plz guide me how should i stop them. Answer ID: 1972 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 696/699=D) In deed the Day of Qiyamah (Doomsday) is imminent: اقتربت الساعۃ (Al-Quran: 1/54). The advent of Hazrat Mahdi, appearance of Dajjal (Antichrist) and second coming of Hazrat Eisa (Alaihis Salam) is undoubtedly true. These things have been mentioned in sahih hadiths. These events will take place at their due time, but they are not too small to remain hidden. These events are amongst the main signs of Qiyamah and they will appear impressively. The one who claims to have met Hazrat Mahdi or Hazrat Eisa is a liar; he even does not know whom he met; Hazrat Mahdi or Hazrat Eisa, whereas there will be no difficulty in recognizing them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
